primarySources.title: Euthyphro
primarySources.creator: Plato
primarySources.excerpt: The point which I should first wish to understand is whether the pious or holy is beloved by the gods because it is holy, or holy because it is beloved of the gods.
primarySources.rightsStatus: Public-domain translation in the United States.
primarySources.teachingUse: Primary dialogue for the Euthyphro question about whether authority alone grounds moral rightness.

primarySources.title: Summa Theologiae, I-II, Questions 90-91
primarySources.creator: Thomas Aquinas
primarySources.translation: Fathers of the English Dominican Province, second revised edition (1920)
primarySources.excerpt: Thus from the four preceding articles, the definition of law may be gathered; and it is nothing else than an ordinance of reason for the common good, made by him who has care of the community, and promulgated.
primarySources.rightsStatus: Public-domain translation in the United States.
primarySources.teachingUse: Primary source for Aquinas's definition of law and four kinds of law.
